headline: Pontegadea, Amancio Ortega's "holding", earns 7.8% more in 2025, surpassing 10,000 million
summary: Pontegadea, the holding company of Amancio Ortega, earned 7.8% more in 2025, surpassing 10,000 million. Its assets are valued at 117,085 million, 5.8% more than in 2024.
why: Pontegadea is the investment vehicle of Spain's richest family, holding large stakes in Inditex and property assets across Europe.
